reviewed_sources.title: Zeta functions of quantum graphs
reviewed_sources.authors: J. M. Harrison and K. Kirsten
reviewed_sources.read_scope: v3 sections 7.3-7.4 in full, including asymptotic subtraction and force derivation (101)-(111); equal-length checks in 7.1-7.2. The earlier v2 section 2 and contour introduction were also inspected; v3 metadata identifies corrected typos and added references. No full dependency or line-by-line edition audit is claimed.
reviewed_sources.comparison: General graph force and determinant methods are established. The new note independently derives its endpoint compression and checks scalar normalization against interval/circle spectra; it does not import a generic secular equation across degenerate lengths.

reviewed_sources.title: Vacuum energy of Schrodinger operators on metric graphs
reviewed_sources.authors: J. M. Harrison and K. Kirsten
reviewed_sources.edition: arXiv:1201.3754v1, 2012-01-18; PDF carries a later typesetting timestamp
reviewed_sources.read_scope: Introduction/Theorem 1.1, interval and graph secular construction in section 3, sections 4-5 including the ultraviolet subtraction, residues, length forces (35)-(37), and the final caveat when compact support is relaxed. The recurrence's cited WKB proof, full classification theorem, publisher edition and all references are not fully audited.
reviewed_sources.comparison: A fixed potential supported inside an edge differs from the clock-dependent mouth profile reaching its endpoint. The finite local subtraction dependence is prior work; the q-scaling and explicit clock variation here concern the previously defined optical model only.

reviewed_sources.title: Traversable wormholes in four dimensions
reviewed_sources.authors: Juan Maldacena, Alexey Milekhin and Fedor Popov
reviewed_sources.read_scope: Reused the Appendix A/A.1 electric/rotational screening review pinned by gauss-mouth-source-review.json; browser confirmed exact v3 and the model/LLL and propagation assumptions in sections 2-3. No new full MMP proof review is claimed.
reviewed_sources.comparison: Screening and subleading finite current sectors are established expectations. The ideal-boundary comparison does not prove those expectations for the full quantum state or local mouth stress.

citation_followup: Backward references in 1201.3754 identify 0911.2509 and 1111.0643; Harrison's author publication list confirms the related publications. The 1111.0643 determinant paper, Fulling-Kaplan-Wilson star-graph predecessor and gluing-formula paper were discovered but not used as independently read proofs. No complete forward-citation review is asserted.
access_notes: Browser HTML fetches for both graph papers and the versioned 1201.3754 PDF initially missed cache; the unversioned PDF parsed successfully, identifies v1, and exact-version PDFs were then retrieved directly and hashed.
A requested browser screenshot of page 8 failed. Equation (35)'s one-half normalization was checked in extracted text and independently against the exact interval/circle spectra.
No separate erratum was identified in the single targeted query. That search is not proof that none exists; the v3 correction history is retained.
novelty_assessment: The graph determinant and Casimir force method, interval/circle energies, and local renormalization issue are established. The uniform rank-dependent comparison supports the existing wormhole investigation; it is not accepted as a consequential novel physical target. Long-return damping and matched finite-duration transfer remain provisional pending the full source/model review.
development_notes: The first full run passed symbolic identities, scattering determinants, equal-return baselines, independent unitary spectra and uniform inequalities, then failed the 2e-7 finite-difference tolerance: the rank-one first derivative had error 2.443558986e-7 at step .005.

A diagnostic at steps .02/.01/.005/.0025 exhibited second-order convergence. The final step .0025 gives first-derivative error 6.108879991e-8 and second-derivative error 4.840315298e-8. Added this refinement without relaxing any tolerance; failed source and diagnostic remain in the ignored reference cache.
